**What gap does this close?** Reference the relevant `ROADMAP.md` row or
`CHANGELOG.md`'s "Honestly still open" section if this is already a named,
tracked gap.

**Proposed approach**, if you have one. Per `CONTRIBUTING.md`'s workflow, a
change to an already-"Implemented" module needs a design doc
(`docs/design/NNN-<name>.md`) reviewed and approved before implementation
starts — this issue can be the seed for that.

**Why this, not an alternative?** If you considered other approaches, a
sentence on the trade-off is more useful than the proposal alone.
